Why do we click? Why do we scroll? The answers often lie deep within our cognitive biases. As a designer with a minor in Psychology, I am fascinated by the intersection of mind and media.

Gestalt Principles in UI

Understanding how the brain groups visual elements (proximity, similarity, continuity) allows us to create interfaces that feel intuitive. When a layout 'feels right', it's often because it respects these innate perceptual laws.

The Von Restorff Effect

Also known as the "isolation effect", this principle states that an item that stands out like a sore thumb is more likely to be remembered. In digital marketing, this is your Call to Action (CTA). Using a contrasting color (like the yellow in this portfolio!) isn't just an aesthetic choice; it's a psychological trigger.
